kebab_example: aliyun linkedmall init-modify-refund --biz-id LMALL202000011224 --biz-uid 2211200002411 --sub-lm-order-id 2300000085 --biz-claim-type 1 --goods-status 1 --use-anonymous-tb-account true --third-party-user-id 2211224110000231 --account-type ANONY --dispute-id 1424400000033071 --api-version 2018-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InitModifyRefund

parameters.help_en: The value must be the same as the value of ThirdPartyUserId
parameters.name: biz_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sub-order for which the refund is initiated
parameters.name: sub_lm_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The refund type. Valid values:
1: refund only.
3: return and refund
parameters.help_zh: 退款类型：1 仅退款，3 退货退款
parameters.name: biz_claim_type

parameters.help_en:
The goods status. When the refund type is refund only, the goods status must be 4 (not shipped). Valid values:
4: not shipped.
6: shipped.
1: not received.
2: received.
3: returned.
5: seller confirmed receipt
parameters.help_zh: 货物状态。当退款类型：仅退款时，货物状态：为4未发货。所有状态：4: 未发货,6:已发货, 1: 未收到货, 2: 已收到货, 3:已寄回, 5:卖家确认收货
parameters.name: goods_status

parameters.help_en: The account type. Set this parameter to ANONY
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: The dispute ID. You can obtain this value by calling the operation that queries the reverse application details of an order
parameters.help_zh: 纠纷ID，通过查询订单逆向申请详情接⼝获取
parameters.name: dispute_id
